newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed 0.16 percent lower on Thursday in active trade, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 591.88 from 592.83 on Wednesday.
Volume was 2.8 million dinars against 3.5 million dinars. Trade on the primary market was particularly active with a 1.29 million dinars turnover versus 243,933 dinars the previous day.
Coke bottler SFBT was up 3.25 dinars to 111.59 with only 120 shares traded. Banque de l'Habitat BHH.TN rose 1.16 dinar to 39.93. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was up 1.07 dinar to 36.81.
Banque Nationale Agricole was down 0.96 dinar to 30.98. Arab Tunisian Bank eased 1.81 to 58.66. Societe Tunisienne de Banques was down 0.63 to 21.95.
